view_AboutUs.title: About Us
view_AboutUs.txt-1: The Chinese Anarchist Association (CAA) is an anarchist organization founded on the tradition of specificism.
view_AboutUs.txt-2: Specificism emphasizes building anarchist organizations with a clear theoretical foundation and practical goals, through collective discussion, organizational development, and social connections, enabling anarchists to act more sustainably, [...]
view_AboutUs.txt-3: The CAA focuses on the realities of Chinese society while drawing on the historical experience and theoretical achievements of the international anarchist movement.
